approaches_tried.approach: git stash to isolate task 688's uncommitted work before checking baseline on a clean tree
approaches_tried.reason: stashed the entire shared working tree (other concurrently-dispatched tasks' uncommitted files too); stash pop then conflicted with a sibling's fresh edit. Recovered by extracting only this task's 3 owned files from the stash via `git show stash@{0}:<path> > <path>`, leaving all sibling files untouched. Lesson: never run a bare `git stash`/`git stash pop` on a shared tree with concurrent siblings; use path-scoped recovery instead.
